name: playtest_setup
description: Not a test — the install step for a hands-on play session. Run with --no-teardown so the branch assemblies, the shader bundles, the mod list and Saves/autostart.rws all stay in place after the harness exits; the game is then launched separately, because run_test.sh always kills the RimWorld it started. Roll the claims back afterwards with run_test.sh --recover-only, which also restores the real ModsConfig.xml.
